c: Search the Caller by name. Their location fills in; a VIP shows an icon and a red field.
say: Start with the caller. Search by name, and their location fills in. A VIP caller shows an icon and a red field.

c: Record the Channel, then the Category; the Subcategory list follows it.
say: Record how they reached you, then the category. The subcategory list follows the category.

c: Choose the device, application or service affected. It can fill the support team for you.
say: Choose the configuration item that is affected. It can fill in the support team for you.

c: Set Impact and Urgency; the Priority fills in by itself.
say: Set impact and urgency. The priority fills in by itself.

c: With a Short description, save: the incident gets its INC number and the caller an email.
say: Write a short description and save. The incident gets its number, and the caller receives an email.
